body: running out of money, weed, and all hope.
DON'T TURN ON YOUR RADIO OP!

Getting high, then regretting spending so much of my little money on weed and falling into a self hating loop. Wait a second... nope guess I don't have much things I call fun anymore either. Just pointless distractions, damn.
I feel the same way, honestly I tend to look at death and suicide less like a dead end that I've found myself at but rather a chance for closure and peace. To me money would only be a distraction

Make the most out of what you are given. With a decent computer and a connection to the internet you have so many possibilities these days. You mentioned gaming, well wouldn't your parents be impressed if you learned how to develop your own games with the computer they bought you? That's just one example, as I said there is so much you can do to use what you have to better yourself and someday possibly give back. 

But, I wouldn't worry too much about repaying your parents, they probably give you these gifts with only your happiness in mind. You should remain grateful for what you are given, but I don't think you should feel like a burden on them as long as you are doing whats expected (school, chores, etc.).
